benchmark_flash_attention: benchmark FlashAttention 2 against PyTorch, Triton, and xFormers attention implementations across multiple batch sizes, sequence lengths, and head dimensions
calculate_flops_attention: calculate FLOPs for attention forward, backward, or combined pass given batch size, sequence length, head dimension, number of heads, and causal flag
compute_attention_efficiency: compute attention efficiency in TFLOPs/s from FLOPs count and measured execution time
measure_fwd_bwd_timing: measure forward and backward pass timing for an attention function using repeated benchmark runs on CUDA
implement_pytorch_attention_baseline: implement a PyTorch baseline attention function using qkv unpacking, baddbmm score computation, softmax, dropout, and einsum output
